column1: # The collector ladder: which tool measures which measure in which lane, in
# order of preference (design thread T1). Tab-separated: lane, measure, tool,
# note. The dispatcher reads this file and never a directory listing; a tool
# listed here whose adapter (scripts/collectors/<tool>.py) does not exist is
# reported as `unavailable` with the reason `adapter not shipped`.
# Three reserved tool names carry a status instead of a collector:
#   none      no maintained collector exists; the note is the reason
#   n/a       the measure does not apply to the lane; the note is the reason
#   deferred  the lane is planned but not shipped; the note is the reason
# A measure of `*` matches every measure not listed explicitly for that lane.
